Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you’re welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.


We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. description:
About Us
Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/
About The Role
We are looking for a
QA Engineer
(manual-first, API-heavy)
to keep a payments platform stable during frequent releases and occasional urgent hotfixes. We don't run strict sprint cycles, so you should be comfortable in a Kanban / continuous delivery setup: clarifying scope, building lightweight test coverage, and shipping fast without breaking critical payment routes.
You will focus on risk-based testing of payment flows, end-to-end API validation (including webhooks), and maintaining pragmatic regression/smoke checklists that balance speed and safety.
Key Responsibilities
Manual testing: validate new features, fixes, and hotfixes across Web UI + APIs.
Risk-based testing: define test scope based on financial / customer impact; call out residual risks.
API / E2E validation: test REST APIs, async flows, and webhooks using Postman/Newman (or equivalent).
Data validation: verify state transitions and side effects in PostgreSQL; understand idempotency and retries.
Regression ownership: maintain and continuously improve smoke + regression suites for critical payment routes.
Incident-to-tests: convert production incidents into new regression cases or monitoring checks.
Collaboration: work closely with engineers/PMs to clarify requirements, reproduce issues, and verify fixes.
Release reporting: provide concise QA notes per release (scope, result, risks, follow-ups).
Qualifications
3+ years in QA with strong manual testing fundamentals.
Strong API testing skills (Postman/Newman, curl, Swagger/OpenAPI).
Practical understanding of: auth vs capture, refunds, webhooks, idempotency, retries.
Basic SQL (PostgreSQL): ability to validate records, joins, state transitions.
Experience with logs/monitoring (Grafana, Kibana/ELK, Sentry or similar).
Comfortable in Kanban / no-sprints / fast-changing requirements.
Good English (written + spoken) for remote async work.
Nice to have
Experience with PSPs (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Braintree, Worldpay, etc.).
Experience with 3DS flows (frictionless vs challenge) and SCA constraints.
Familiarity with test automation frameworks (pytest, Playwright) and CI (ability to read/maintain existing checks is a plus).
Understanding of network tokenization (DPAN / network tokens).
Location
Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.
Benefits
Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Diagnosing and correcting improper quality control practices using metrology and statistical methods. Conducts capability studies of plant and supplier manufacturing processes.

  • Audits internal quality systems for deficiencies.

  • Review engineering drawings and specifications to ensure the measurability of key features. Review tolerances of key features to ensure manufacturability. Define measurement methods at plants and suppliers to establish consistency of measurement. 

  • Represent the QA department in new projects, as required. Aid team in reviewing customer specifications, project-specific quality planning and supplier coordination. 

  • Develops Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for existing and new products and coordinate implementation with plant Quality Assurance personnel. Includes new testing/inspection techniques and fixture/gauge design. 

  • Using established specifications, evaluates finished products, purchased products, and raw materials.

  • Utilizes physical, mechanical, and electrical testing procedures and inspection equipment to perform routine Quality/Materials Lab tasks. 

  • Interprets engineering recommendations, customer specifications, and engineering drawings for suppliers or PLP facilities.

  • Conducts source inspection of suppliers. Conducts supplier Quality System audits. Works with key suppliers to implement required improvements. 

  • Investigates field complaints and product failures. Analyzes problems, solutions, or recommendations after proper engineering and laboratory studies. Helps to determine causes of material failures.

  • Assists engineers and plant personnel in reducing the instances of nonconformities and the quantity of non-conforming product produced in the plants. Uses Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action tools to effect improvements. Drives reduction in component, WIP, and finished good nonconformities through improvements in process controls, better gauging methods, and product specification rationalization. Follows up on a regular basis until improvements have been verified.

  • Assists suppliers who are having difficulty with meeting Quality expectations due to part non-conformance. Uses Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action tools to effect improvements. Follows up with suppliers on a regular basis until improvements have been verified.

  • Develops and conducts material test procedures to comply with industry and customer specifications. Prepares and performs analysis in support of product development. 

  • Maintains the Supplier Risk Assessment and Inspection Level programs. 

  • Provides support of the Customer Feedback database and follows up with Engineering, PLP plants, suppliers, and Marketing and Sales to verify that an answer has been provided. 

  • Has familiarity with and implements Lean techniques for continuous improvement.

The Wabtec Mining team delivers world class electric drive propulsion systems for heavy haul mining trucks with payloads up to 400T. These systems are introducing new technology to help mines meet their sustainability goals.

How will you make a difference?

In this role you will work with the control team to develop, implement, and validate controls for electric drive mining vehicles. You’ll have the opportunity to interact directly with customers and cross functional teams during project definition and execution.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent field)
  • Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in:
    • Control and system validation for motors, alternators, and power electronic systems
    • Electromechanical system testing
    • System design and circuit analysis
    • EMC testing and compliance
    • Modeling and analysis using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink
    • Project management

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent tests at the customer proving ground, including truck‑level EMC and propulsion validation, as well as component and feature V&V—ensuring safety, compliance, logistics, materials, staffing, and communication needs are met.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the customer and coordinate with site management and test personnel on planning and execution.
  • Resolve assigned field issues.
  • Travel periodically for 1–3 week durations to support testing and issue investigations.

Candidates will be conducting testing at a customer’s proving grounds and periodically may work in a full-scale propulsion system test lab or support field testing at mines. The below physical capabilities are essential:
